keys.name: idrecording
keys.label: Identification
keys.desc: What the node sends to identify itself: `|i` followed by the callsign is sent in Morse code, anything else names a sound recording. Amateur radio rules usually require the callsign to be sent regularly.

keys.name: idtalkover
keys.label: Talkover identification
keys.desc: What is sent instead of the normal identification while someone is talking, so the ID does not interrupt them. Leave empty for none.

keys.name: idtime
keys.label: Identification interval
keys.desc: How often the node identifies itself while it is in use. 0 turns the periodic ID off.

keys.name: politeid
keys.label: Polite ID window
keys.desc: How long before the ID is due the node tries to send it in a gap between transmissions rather than over a conversation.

keys.name: callerid
keys.label: Caller ID
keys.desc: The name and number shown to phone-style (autopatch) callers. Does not affect radio operation.

keys.name: rxchannel
keys.label: Radio channel
keys.desc: Which interface carries the node's audio and radio signalling, for example SimpleUSB/<node> for a USB sound adapter, or Local/pseudo for a hub with no radio. The matching driver must be loaded in modules.conf.

keys.name: duplex
keys.label: Duplex mode
keys.desc: How the node's radio behaves. 0: half duplex, no telemetry tones or hang time (for a link radio or an external controller). 1: half duplex with tones and hang time, audio is not repeated (hotspot or simplex node). 2: full duplex with tones and hang time (repeater). 3: full duplex, audio is not repeated. 4: full duplex, audio is repeated only while no autopatch call is up.

keys.name: linktolink
keys.label: Link to link
keys.desc: With duplex 0, yes makes the node run full duplex (for a repeater controlled by an external controller). Otherwise yes disables forcing the radio to half duplex while keeping half duplex behaviour.

keys.name: hangtime
keys.label: Hang time
keys.desc: How long the transmitter stays on after the last person stops talking, so replies are not clipped. Values below 1 ms count as 1 ms.

keys.name: althangtime
keys.label: Alternate hang time
keys.desc: A second, longer hang time that users can switch to with a DTMF function.

keys.name: totime
keys.label: Time-out timer
keys.desc: The longest a single transmission may last before the transmitter is shut off. Protects the node from a stuck transmitter.

keys.name: time_out_reset_unkey_interval
keys.label: Time-out reset gap
keys.desc: After a time-out, how long the signal must be absent before the timer resets. Filters noise and picket fencing.

keys.name: telemdefault
keys.label: Telemetry output
keys.desc: Which beeps and voice messages (courtesy tones, connect messages) the node sends. 0: none. 1: all of them. 2: only for a short time after a command.

keys.name: telemdynamic
keys.label: Users may change telemetry
keys.desc: yes stops users from changing the telemetry setting with a DTMF command; no lets them.

keys.name: holdofftelem
keys.label: Hold off telemetry while receiving
keys.desc: 1 keeps beeps and messages from being sent while someone is being received.

keys.name: nounkeyct
keys.label: Disable courtesy tones
keys.desc: 1 turns the courtesy tone after each transmission off, together with the delay it adds.

keys.name: unlinkedct
keys.label: Courtesy tone, not linked
keys.desc: Tone sent after a transmission while the node is not linked to another node. Name of an entry in the [telemetry] stanza.

keys.name: remotect
keys.label: Courtesy tone, linked
keys.desc: Tone sent after a transmission while a remote node is linked. Name of an entry in the [telemetry] stanza.

keys.name: linkunkeyct
keys.label: Courtesy tone, link unkeys
keys.desc: Tone sent when a transmission arriving over a link ends. Name of an entry in the [telemetry] stanza.

keys.name: tailmessagetime
keys.label: Tail message interval
keys.desc: How often a tail message (a recording played between transmissions) is sent. 0 turns tail messages off.

keys.name: parrot
keys.label: Parrot mode
keys.desc: 1 echoes everything the node receives back to the sender after a short wait. 0 leaves it off unless switched on with a DTMF command.

keys.name: linkmongain
keys.label: Monitored link gain
keys.desc: Volume change in dB for nodes that are only monitored. Negative is quieter.

keys.name: erxgain
keys.label: EchoLink receive gain
keys.desc: Volume change in dB for audio arriving from EchoLink.

keys.name: etxgain
keys.label: EchoLink transmit gain
keys.desc: Volume change in dB for audio sent to EchoLink.

keys.name: context
keys.label: Dialplan context
keys.desc: Which part of extensions.conf handles calls to and from this node. Change only if you know the dialplan.

keys.name: startup_macro
keys.label: Startup macro
keys.desc: DTMF commands run once when the node starts, for example to connect to a favourite node. Needs a restart of Asterisk to take effect at the next start.

keys.name: statpost_url
keys.label: Status reporting address
keys.desc: Where the node reports its status and links, for the public statistics pages. Empty: no reporting.

keys.name: statpost_time
keys.label: Status reporting interval
keys.desc: How often the node reports its connected links.

keys.name: node_lookup_method
keys.label: Node lookup method
keys.desc: How other nodes are found: dns asks the AllStar DNS, file uses a local list, both tries DNS first.

keys.name: enabled
keys.label: Manager interface enabled
keys.desc: Whether Asterisk accepts management connections. ASLCP and other tools need this on.

keys.name: bindaddr
keys.label: Manager listen address
keys.desc: Which address the management interface listens on. 127.0.0.1 allows this computer only.

keys.name: port
keys.label: Manager port
keys.desc: TCP port of the management interface.

keys.name: secret
keys.label: Manager password
keys.desc: Password of the admin management login. Changing it breaks every tool that still uses the old one, ASLCP included until it is told.

keys.name: bindport
keys.label: IAX port
keys.desc: UDP port nodes use to link to this node. Other nodes must be told if it is not 4569.

keys.name: call
keys.label: EchoLink callsign
keys.desc: Your EchoLink callsign, with -L or -R for a link or repeater station.

keys.name: pwd
keys.label: EchoLink password
keys.desc: Your EchoLink password.

keys.name: name
keys.label: Name shown on EchoLink
keys.desc: The name other EchoLink users see.

keys.name: qth
keys.label: Location shown on EchoLink
keys.desc: The location other EchoLink users see.

keys.name: email
keys.label: Contact e-mail
keys.desc: Contact address sent to the EchoLink directory.

keys.name: astnode
keys.label: AllStar node
keys.desc: The node that EchoLink calls are connected to. Must be one of this server's nodes.

keys.name: maxstns
keys.label: Most stations
keys.desc: The most EchoLink stations that may be connected at once.

keys.name: freq
keys.label: Frequency
keys.desc: Frequency in MHz shown in the EchoLink directory. Not required.

keys.name: tone
keys.label: CTCSS tone
keys.desc: CTCSS tone in Hz shown in the EchoLink directory. 0 for none.

keys.name: power
keys.label: Power class
keys.desc: Directory power class, 0 to 9 (0 W, 1 W, 4 W, 9 W and so on).

keys.name: height
keys.label: Antenna height class
keys.desc: Directory antenna height class, 0 to 9.

keys.name: gain
keys.label: Antenna gain
keys.desc: Directory antenna gain in dB, 0 to 9.

keys.name: dir
keys.label: Antenna direction
keys.desc: Directory antenna direction, 0 (omni) to 8.

keys.name: carrierfrom
keys.label: Carrier detect from
keys.desc: Where the node learns that a signal is being received: nowhere (no), the USB adapter pin (usb) or the inverted pin (usbinvert).

keys.name: ctcssfrom
keys.label: CTCSS detect from
keys.desc: Where the node learns that the right CTCSS tone is present: nowhere (no), the USB adapter pin (usb) or the inverted pin (usbinvert).

keys.name: invertptt
keys.label: Invert PTT
keys.desc: yes if the radio transmits when the PTT line is open instead of closed.

keys.name: rxboost
keys.label: Receive boost
keys.desc: yes removes the 20 dB attenuator on the receive audio input of the adapter.

keys.name: preemphasis
keys.label: Pre-emphasis
keys.desc: yes applies the standard 6 dB per octave pre-emphasis to transmit audio.

keys.name: deemphasis
keys.label: De-emphasis
keys.desc: yes applies de-emphasis to received audio, for a radio whose audio comes straight from the discriminator.

keys.name: plfilter
keys.label: PL filter
keys.desc: yes filters the CTCSS tone out of received audio.

presets.name: simplex
presets.label: Simplex node or hotspot
presets.desc: One radio, half duplex, with courtesy tones and hang time. Audio is not repeated.

presets.name: halfduplexlink
presets.label: Link radio, half duplex
presets.desc: A link radio next to a repeater controller: half duplex, no tones and no hang time.

presets.name: repeater
presets.label: Repeater
presets.desc: Full duplex with tones and hang time; received audio is repeated.

presets.name: hub
presets.label: Hub, no radio
presets.desc: A node without a radio that only links other nodes together.
